message.content: This illustration serves as a magazine cover for "TEMPO," with the word printed in large red serif letters across the top. Below, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN P" is partially visible. The central figure is a light-skinned, shirtless man with dark, bowl-cut hair, glasses, and a focused expression. He is shown from the waist up, holding a clear, faceted glass of water to his eye, peering through it. His body displays a literal transformation: his torso and abdominal area are integrated with a translucent, gray, multi-segmented plastic structure resembling a stack of large mineral water jugs. This structure replaces his waist and lower ribcage, following the shape of his torso. The background is plain white. To the lower left, text reads: "Mikroplastik di Perut Kita" and a paragraph beginning with "Kemasan air mineral melepaskan mikroplastik..." Other legible text at the top includes "Geliat Industri Metaverse Tanah Air H.66" and "Manuver Jokowi Menjelang KTT G20 H.24." A barcode, QR code, and "9-15 MEI 2022 RP 50.000" are in the top right corner.
